name: SQL Managed Instance
summary: Near-100% SQL Server compatible managed database instance inside your VNet, for lifting and shifting SQL Server workloads that need instance-level features.
useWhen: You migrate a SQL Server workload that uses SQL Agent, cross-database queries, CLR, linked servers or Service Broker
You need a database with a private IP inside your VNet and no public endpoint
avoidWhen: A single new cloud-native database is enough (Azure SQL Database is cheaper and deploys in minutes)
You need a quick lab deployment: the first instance in a subnet can take several hours and needs a dedicated, prepared subnet
